summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle on install
details: The package's declared preinstall script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from GitHub, extracts the `bun` executable to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and immediately execs it against a sibling `math_init.js` file (~727KB, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, hex-identifier variables, rotated string-array with a shift-based decoder). Because the payload is executed by a freshly downloaded alternate JavaScript runtime, Node-based inspection of the installer's tooling never observes what the bundle does. The package presents itself as a React line-item-editor UI component library, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate runtime or execute a large obfuscated bundle at `npm install` time. The `@servicetitan/*` scope and repository reference (`servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib`) invoke the ServiceTitan brand, extending the blast radius if the scope is not legitimately controlled by that vendor. Installing the package auto-executes attacker-supplied opaque code on the developer or CI host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
